verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Come and let Your presence
Fill our praise, fill our praise
Come and let Your presence fill this place

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
For You are the one we want to meet
Jesus, shine through all the praises that we sing

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
We have come to give You
Highest praise, highest praise
We have come to love You in this place

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
It's all for You
Here we are, here we are

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
We love You, we love You, Lord
You're the one we came here for
We love You, we love You, Lord
You're the one our hearts adore

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
This is what we came here for
This is what You made us for
To see Your face
To see Your face

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines: Be the one our hearts adore
